# FitHub

> FitHub is a gym management platform for independent gyms and boutique fitness studios. It replaces spreadsheets and paper sign-in sheets with one operator dashboard covering memberships, attendance, class scheduling, billing, staff access, and revenue analytics.

FitHub is built and operated by RankSol. It is sold as a monthly or annual SaaS subscription with a 14-day free trial and no credit card required to start.

## Core capabilities

- Membership management: onboard members, track plans, and get renewal-lapse alerts before a member churns.
- QR check-in: members scan a QR code at the front desk to check themselves in — no manual sign-in sheets.
- Class scheduling and bookings: gym staff publish a class schedule; members book and cancel their own spot from the member app.
- Billing and payments: Stripe-powered subscription billing with invoices and payment history visible to members.
- Staff and trainer accounts: scoped staff logins limit access instead of sharing one full-admin login.
- Analytics and insight dashboard: MRR, churn risk, attendance trends, and revenue reporting in real time.
- Member mobile app: members view their plan, attendance streak, and class bookings from a dedicated app.

## Audience

Independent gym owners, boutique fitness studio operators, and small gym chains who currently run their business on spreadsheets, paper logs, or disconnected tools (a booking tool, a separate payments tool, a separate spreadsheet).
